effect_description_eng: ＜Alliance＞ ＜Collision＞ ＜Piercing＞ ＜Blocker＞ [When Digivolving] You may play up to 8 play cost's total worth of cards with [Knightmon] in their texts from your hand without paying the cost. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your other Digimon are played or deleted, by trashing 1 [LordKnightmon] or [X Antibody] from this Digimon's digivolution cards, activate 1 [Main] effect on this card's Option side.

option.effect_text: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's lowest level Digimon. If this effect didn't delete, until your turn ends, all of your Digimon with [Knightmon] in their texts gain ＜Blocker＞, your opponent's Digimon effects don't affect them and they get +3000 DP.
